name: spin
concept: A full, continuous, constant-speed rotation. The most familiar way to say something is loading or working, with no sense of progress.

name: spin-reverse
concept: The same continuous rotation as spin, reversed. Useful to pair two spinners that should visibly counter-rotate, or a sync icon spinning against its usual direction.

name: shimmer
concept: A soft gradient highlight sweeps across the element, continuous. Reads as a placeholder standing in for content that has not arrived yet.

name: dots-bounce
concept: Three dots bounce one after another in a continuous loop. Reads as someone typing, or a system thinking before it replies.

name: progress-sweep
concept: A bar sweeps back and forth across its track, continuous. For a loading bar when there is no percentage to report, only that work is happening.
